description: Create a detached tmux session (starting the tmux server if needed). Optional name, working directory (default $HOME), first window name and a shell command to run instead of the default shell. With remain_on_exit, the pane stays once its program ends, dead, for tmux::panes::respawn to restart it.

account.description: `global` (the default: it runs on the global account and moves when that changes) or an account id (pinned to it).

skip_permissions.description: Start it with --dangerously-skip-permissions (default false). Refused when the host runs as root.

claude.description: Start Claude Code on an account in the first window instead of `command` (not both): the worker builds the command (returned as `runs`) and marks the pane with its account.

command.description: Shell command to run in the first window instead of the default shell.

cwd.description: Working directory, absolute or `~/…`. Defaults to $HOME.

name.description: Session name; tmux picks a number when omitted. No `:` or `.`.

remain_on_exit.description: Keep the pane once its program ends, shown dead, so tmux::panes::respawn can restart it (default false: tmux closes it). On tmux before 3.0, which has no pane options, every pane of its window is kept.

runs.description: With `claude`: the exact command the pane runs.
